title_zh: RailWeave 三项重点项目交付账本
title_en: RailWeave Delivery Ledger for Three Priority Projects
authority_boundary_zh: 本账本汇编概念项目台账、成本取证计划、责任接续记录及可公开核验的既有项目事实。AI原点首期候选载体的地址、1650平方米既有装修工程规模、既有装修招标人、施工许可、联合验收和一次‘展厅—北门—社区大街’参访链路已有公开记录；这些记录只用于确定首轮对接与踏勘线索，不构成RailWeave场地授权、现场或无障碍调查、责任接收、预算、采购、合作或实施事实。三个项目均停留在G0前置核验状态；所有角色均为待依法任命的原型。工程量、项目专项报价、预算资金、采购合同、场地权利、专业条件和现场绩效未确认前，不得转段或表述为已具备实施条件。
authority_boundary_en: This ledger compiles the conceptual project register, cost-evidence plan, responsibility handoffs, and verifiable public facts about existing projects. Public records verify the address, the 1,650 m² scale of the existing fit-out project, existing-fit-out procuring entity, construction permit, joint acceptance, and one reported hall → north gate → community street visit to the preferred AI Origin candidate venue. Those records establish first-engagement and survey clues only; they constitute neither RailWeave site authorisation nor a field or accessibility survey, responsibility acceptance, budget, procurement, partnership, or implementation. All three projects remain at the G0 prerequisite-verification stage, and every role is an archetype awaiting lawful appointment. No project may advance or be described as implementable until quantities, project-specific quotations, budget funding, procurement contracts, site rights, professional conditions, and field performance are confirmed.

global_confirmation_status.status_zh: AI原点候选展厅的既有工程公开记录已核；主体仍未任命，RailWeave场地权利、预算、项目专项价格、现场条件、采购合同和实施授权均未确认，项目未启动。
global_confirmation_status.status_en: Public records for the existing AI Origin candidate hall have been verified. Entities remain unassigned, while RailWeave site rights, budget, project-specific prices, field conditions, procurement contracts, and implementation authorisation are unconfirmed; no project has started.
